validated_findings.selective_residency: Only one transformer layer is materialized at a time; remaining transformer layers remain META.
validated_findings.per_tensor_int8: Approximately 2x storage compression, but large accumulated numerical error.
validated_findings.per_channel_int8: Approximately 2x storage compression with substantially improved numerical fidelity relative to per-tensor INT8.
validated_findings.mixed_mlp_int8: MLP-only INT8 provides the strongest tested accuracy/storage tradeoff.
validated_findings.performance: Dequantization/reconstruction dominates the current INT8 execution path.
validated_findings.generation: Manual layer-streaming generation produced diagnostic output, but DynamicCache did not grow in this Transformers implementation, so generation is not treated as a validated KV-cache benchmark.
